name: flowbite-admin-dashboard
description: Free and open-source admin dashboard template built with Tailwind CSS and Flowbite

paragraphs: This project is a free and open-source UI admin dashboard template built with the components from Flowbite and based on the utility-first Tailwind CSS framework featuring charts, tables, widgets, CRUD layouts, modals, drawers, and more.

This admin dashboard can quickly help you get started building an application for your project using the newest UI/UX development technologies in the open-source area including Tailwind CSS and Flowbite.

whatItDoes.text: This project is a free and open-source UI admin dashboard template built with the components from Flowbite and based on the utility-first Tailwind CSS framework featuring charts, tables, widgets, CRUD layouts, modals, drawers, and more.

requirements.text: Get started with 15 advanced examples pages including two different layouts of a dashboard's homepage full of charts widgets, tables, datepickers, and statistics and also with two CRUD layout pages for products, users, a settings page, authentication pages for login and register and even custom 404 and 500 error pages.
